bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; printf 'PWD='; pwd; printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current; printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD; printf 'ORIGIN='; git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#https://[^@/]+@#https://#'; printf 'DIRTY_COUNT='; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l; printf 'WORKTREES='; git worktree list --porcelain | grep -c '^worktree '; printf 'COMPOSE_DIRS='; find deploy -maxdepth 2 -iname '*compose*' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l; printf 'STICKER_INVENTORY='; test -f src/stickers/pgStickerInventory.mjs && echo YES || echo NO; printf 'STICKER_MAPPING='; test -f docs/STICKER_FUNCTION_MAPPING.md && echo YES || echo NO
